target_audience: University students with a basic understanding of algebra and probability

sections.title: Introduction: The Trust Problem
lecture_lines: Digital scarcity requires trust without central authority.
We introduce three core mathematical concepts.
Second, Asymmetric Encryption provides digital ownership.
animations: Create a '#FFFFFF' colored rectangle representing a ledger.
Animate a question mark appearing near the ledger using '#FFFF00'.
Fade out question mark and display 'Trustless' text in '#00FF00'.

sections.title: Cryptographic Hashing: The Digital Fingerprint
lecture_lines: Hashing is a one-way mathematical function.
Input any data to get a unique fingerprint.
Changing even one bit changes the output entirely.
animations: Display a string of random data as a '#FFFFFF' block.
Show a hash function transforming it into a fixed '#FF00FF' hash.
Highlight the fixed hash with a '#00FFFF' glow effect.

sections.title: Asymmetric Cryptography: Digital Ownership
lecture_lines: Public keys are derived from private keys.
The private key signs transactions securely.
The public key verifies these digital signatures.
animations: Create a Public Key shape labeled '#FFFF00'.
Create a Private Key shape labeled '#FF0000'.
Animate signing a transaction connecting both keys with '#00FF00'.

sections.title: Proof of Work: The Lottery of Consensus
lecture_lines: Mining is a race to solve puzzles.
Miners find a nonce for specific hashes.
This secures the network through computational energy.
animations: Draw a series of circles representing miners.
Animate a race among circles to find a '#FFFF00' nonce.
Flash the winning circle with '#00FF00' to show consensus.

sections.title: The Mathematical Security of the Chain
lecture_lines: Blocks are linked using previous block hashes.
This creates an immutable history of records.
Tampering with one block invalidates the chain.
animations: Display block 1 and 2 connected with '#FFFFFF' lines.
Add a link using the hash from block 1 to 2.
Show the chain structure strengthening with a '#00FF00' color shift.
